fato_historico: 2025: A landslide in the Darfur region of Sudan kills over 1000 people.
energia_do_dia: Today, consider how deeply rooted you are within the earth of your own soul. Just as the world remembers the fragility of life and the strength found in mourning, you may feel an invitation to hold space for others. It is a good time to turn your fiery passion into a steady, comforting glow for your community.
frase_do_dia: Even in shadows, your inner spark remains a guide for those you love.
significado_numero: A powerful master number representing intuition and spiritual awakening for your path.
conselho: Practice patience today and offer a gentle hand to someone walking a difficult path.
